Reviewer: registered Brainstorm thread `01a136be-732f-7350-b9f5-13d1dddc5ddb`, assignment `castle-source-review-001`.

1. **The v27 proof gate permits downgrade to legacy validation.** [route_contract.py:189](/private/tmp/castle-builder-004-fixture-corrected/scripts/route_contract.py:189) selects v2 solely from caller-supplied `proof_schema`. Its [file check:207](/private/tmp/castle-builder-004-fixture-corrected/scripts/route_contract.py:207) also accepts any truthy sentinel, including `"Untitled"`. Thus the required v27 proof is optional at the public gate.

2. **V2 can accept explicitly failed nested read results.** [route_contract.py:355](/private/tmp/castle-builder-004-fixture-corrected/scripts/route_contract.py:355) checks outer `status` and result shape, then filepath/collections, but never nested `result.status`. An outer-success payload retaining those fields with nested `"status":"error"` satisfies these conditions. The existing [readiness.py:29](/private/tmp/castle-builder-004-fixture-corrected/scripts/readiness.py:29) correctly rejects that case. This is a source-derived counterexample; I did not execute it.
